allGivenAndContext.reviewStatus: Original wording retained; geometric crop plus complete source context.

attempts.firstAnswer: Improved lenses increased useful microscope magnification and allowed observation of cells and their division; evidence of division supported the conclusion that cells arise from pre-existing cells rather than spontaneous generation. allGivenAndContext.label: Section 16 1 · p. 555 · question 4
allGivenAndContext.sourceText:
4. Contrast the two terms in each pair of terms.
 
 a) haploid and diploid
 
 b) chromatin and chromosome
 
 c) XX and XY
allGivenAndContext.reviewStatus: Original wording retained; geometric crop plus complete source context.

firstAnswer.a: Haploid means one complete chromosome set; diploid means two. For the typical human model, n = 23 and 2n = 46.
firstAnswer.b: Chromatin is DNA and associated proteins; chromosomes are distinct organized units of that material. Less condensed chromatin exists between divisions; condensation makes individual chromosomes visible. These are not different hereditary substances.
firstAnswer.c: XX means two X sex chromosomes, associated with typical female cells in this model; XY means one X and one Y, associated with typical male cells. X and Y do not match over their entire lengths.

attempts.qualification: Question crop cuts off part (c); complete full-page image and original PDF visibly supply “c) XX and XY”. The answer uses all a/b/c, not just cropped a/b.
